name: High Desire
source:
High Desire is an episodic Adult Visual Novel game that puts you, the player, in the shoes of a conflicted young man with big dreams of becoming a racing driver. But instead, he finds himself swept up in the world of illegal street racing.

As the player, You will navigate through a compelling storyline, filled with tough decisions that will steer the outcome of the game.

But it's not just about racing. Along the way, You will have to deal with complex relationships with the women in your life, each with their own distinct personalities and motivations. How You handle these relationships will ultimately shape and influence the outcome of the game.

[From the [url=https://www.wingmenlabs.com]official site[/url]]
translation:
《High Desire》是一部章节式成人视觉小说游戏。玩家将扮演一名内心充满挣扎的年轻男子，原本怀揣着成为职业赛车手的远大梦想，却阴差阳错地被卷入了地下非法街头赛车的世界。

作为玩家，你将置身于扣人心弦的剧情之中，面对重重艰难抉择，亲手左右故事的最终走向。

但这不仅是一个关于赛车的故事。一路走来，你还必须处理与身边多位女性之间错综复杂的情感纠葛，她们各自都有着鲜明的性格与动机。你如何对待这些关系，将最终塑造并决定整场游戏的结局。

[摘自[url=https://www.wingmenlabs.com]官方网站[/url]]
